name: gizza-ai/bollinger-bands
summary: Bollinger Bands (moving average plus/minus standard deviations)

tool.description: Compute Bollinger Bands for a price/value series (separated by spaces, commas, semicolons, or newlines, oldest first). For each rolling window of `period` values (default 20) the middle band is the simple moving average and the upper/lower bands are the SMA plus/minus `num_std` (default 2) population standard deviations. Also returns %B and bandwidth for the latest point. Runs locally.

prices.description: The price/value series, separated by spaces, commas, semicolons, or newlines (oldest first).

period.description: Moving-average window length (the SMA period). Defaults to 20.

num_std.description: Standard-deviation multiplier for the upper/lower bands. Defaults to 2.
